text: QUYẾT ĐÁNH GIẶC TÔ ĐỊNH! QUYẾT ĐÁNH ĐUỔI LOÀI ÁC TẶC PHƯƠNG BẮC!
speaker: Toàn thể tướng sĩ và tộc trưởng
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a standalone historical Vietnamese comic speech balloon ASSET: draw BOTH the organic hand-inked cloud frame AND all Vietnamese lettering inside in one image. Transparent RGBA outside, no scene/people. Match supplied PAGE14 dawn ink-hatching/watercolor illustration: pale cool ivory-gray paper with very subtle peach reflected dawn edge, dark uneven ink contours, not yellow, not white UI box, no drop shadow. Wide cloud body ~3.7:1; complete asset including tail ~3:1. Strong but readable humanist serif comic lettering, uppercase, dark ink, all accents exact, generous padding. One short curved tail emerges lower center toward collective crowd below, tail only ~12% total height, no long triangle. Text verbatim, exactly three centered lines:
QUYẾT ĐÁNH GIẶC TÔ ĐỊNH!
QUYẾT ĐÁNH ĐUỔI LOÀI ÁC TẶC
PHƯƠNG BẮC!
No extra text, no quotation marks. This is a historical-legend book scene of collective oath, no depicted violence. Preserve wording exactly.
